THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
AT SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, Shiltong the 3INovember, 2026
No. HCM. I1/111/2021/Pt-ll/Estt/aCE Hon’ble the Chief Justice is pleased to
nominate the Joint Registrar (Listing) as the Nodal Officer for FASTER (Fast and
Secured Transmission of Electronic Records), High Court of Meghalaya, for the
purpose of facilitating the timely receipt, processing, transmission, monitoring and
ensuring compliance with orders passed by the Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and
transmitted through the FASTER system to this High Court and the concerned District
Courts.
The Nodal Officer of the High Court shall coordinate with the registry of the
Hon’ble Supreme Court of India and shall ensure the compliance of the orders sent
to the High Court and to the concerned District Court through the secured jcn email
domain created by NIC.
The Nodal Officer shall also ensure that the orders received through the
FASTER system are duly communicated to the concerned authorities and that
necessary follow-up action is undertaken to facilitate timely compliance with the
directions contained therein.
REGISTRAR GENERAL
